gate_1_leakage_safe_evaluation.requirement: Zero candidate, job, or pair intersection between train and evaluation partitions.
gate_1_leakage_safe_evaluation.evidence: ProtocolSplitGuard enforces strict entity disjointness; zero hash overlap in dual_unseen_val_v1.

gate_2_independent_benchmark_performance.requirement: Demonstrated generalization on an external or disjoint recruiter-labelled benchmark.
gate_2_independent_benchmark_performance.evidence: Evaluated on clean Dual-Unseen validation; external Djinni benchmark remains unlabelled.

gate_3_improvement_over_production_basel.requirement: Statistically defensible improvement over production Logistic Regression (Acc: 36.82%).
gate_3_improvement_over_production_basel.evidence: Contrastive projector achieves 44.60% (mean delta: +6.42%, candidate-cluster 95% CI strictly positive).

gate_4_stronger_three_class_performance.requirement: Balanced accuracy and Macro F1 improvements, not merely accuracy consolidation on majority class.
gate_4_stronger_three_class_performance.evidence: Unweighted Macro F1 gain is only +0.0025 under argmax; recovered to 0.3699 only after out-of-fold threshold calibration. Good Fit recall remains low (12.9%).

gate_5_reproducible_multiseed_results.requirement: Verified stability across 5 independent random training seeds.
gate_5_reproducible_multiseed_results.evidence: 4 of 5 seeds replicate accuracy gain (Seed 44 identified as optimization local minimum).

gate_6_acceptable_inference_latency_and_.status: PASSED (Bi-Encoder: 0.014 ms, 81 MB) / PASSED (Cross-Encoder: 15.4 ms, 420 MB)
gate_6_acceptable_inference_latency_and_.evidence: Both architectures operate well within operational serving budgets.

gate_7_verified_artifact_integrity.requirement: Production checkpoint SHA-256 and feature pipeline bit-for-bit preserved.
gate_7_verified_artifact_integrity.evidence: models/best_model.joblib and models/feature_pipeline.joblib hashes cryptographically verified intact.

gate_8_regression_and_deployment_tests_p.requirement: 100% test pass rate across unit, integration, and security suites.
gate_8_regression_and_deployment_tests_p.evidence: Full regression test suite passes with zero failures.

justification: While representation learning improves accuracy by +6.42%, three-class Macro F1 gains remain modest (+0.0025 unweighted, +0.0388 OOF calibrated), and Good Fit recall remains under 15%. Dual-Unseen accuracy (~45-48%) does not meet the 65%+ production deployment threshold. Production model best_model.joblib remains active in production.
